summary: Validated all 11 NEW StudyPilot endpoints (voice, snap, mood, mood/history, burnout-score, daily-spark, daily-spark/refresh, streak, reels/generate, reels/{id}, explain-three-ways) end-to-end against live backend with fresh JWT signup. 15/15 pytest cases pass (includes auth guards + 404 sanity). All AI generations validated for response shape, key fields and data types. Full suite runs in ~65s.

minor.issue: Endpoint relies entirely on the user-supplied image being valid+large enough for Anthropic vision. A trivial 1x1 placeholder JPEG triggers an Anthropic 'Could not process image' error which surfaces to the client as HTTP 500 (uncaught ChatError). Recommend wrapping ai.snap_solve in try/except → 400 with friendly message so bad uploads don't look like server crashes.

Stored `created_at` is an ISO string, but /wellbeing/burnout-score and /wellbeing/streak compare with $gte against an ISO string too — works because lex-order matches time-order for ISO Z strings, but mixing string and datetime types across collections is fragile. Consider standardising on datetime objects.
Short-circuits when reels already exist for the study_set (same pattern as flashcards). No way to regenerate without manual DB cleanup. Consider a force=true flag.

action_items: Wrap ai.snap_solve() in try/except inside /api/studypilotai/snap and convert Anthropic image-validation failures into HTTP 400 with a clear message ('Could not process image, please retry with a clearer photo').
Optional: add force=true flag to /api/reels/generate to allow regeneration (currently returns cached reels if any exist).
Optional: enforce explicit datetime objects (not ISO strings) in wellbeing collections for safer date range queries.
critical_code_review_comments: ai.py snap_solve: no error handling around vision call; any LLM/image error bubbles up as a generic 500. Add try/except.

server.py burnout-score: avg_per_day = sessions / 7.0 then score = avg*8 + ... — magic constants and integer score capped at 100, but no lower bound enforcement (negative not possible here, just noting). Document the formula.
server.py reels_generate: like flashcards, idempotency is implicit via 'if existing return existing' — good for cost but bad for UX when user wants new reels. Add explicit regenerate path.
server.py daily-spark uses calendar date string but no timezone consideration — user's local 'today' may differ from UTC, leading to spark resetting at unexpected times.
explain_three_ways trims input to 6000 chars in ai.py but server.py only checks len >= 10 — fine, just noting truncation is silent.
seed_data_creation: Per-run: 1 user, 1 study set (Photosynthesis TXT, ~700 chars), 1 mood checkin, 1 daily spark, 5 reels for the study set. All keyed to throwaway user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files now exist: /app/backend/tests/test_studypilot_api.py (original 25 tests, all passing per iteration_1) and /app/backend/tests/test_new_endpoints.py (15 new-endpoint tests, all passing). Both are idempotent (fresh signup per run) and reuse the auth.py fix from iteration_1. Snap test uses an in-memory PIL-generated 300x100 JPEG (Pillow is already installed) — Claude vision rejects images that are too small, so DO NOT shrink it. AI endpoints take 5-90s each; 120s timeout is safe. Always export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL when running pytest manually since /app/backend/.env does not contain it.
rca of the issue: No new bugs surfaced. Two transient failures in the first run (snap → 500 from Anthropic 'Could not process image' on a 1x1 placeholder JPEG; daily-spark/refresh → 502 preview gateway timeout) were both addressed at the test layer: snap test now generates a valid 300x100 PIL JPEG, and the gateway recovered on retry. Production code path for /studypilotai/snap should still be hardened to convert vision-validation errors into HTTP 400 instead of 500.
